correctness.rationale: For independent vertex layers joined completely in sequence, every pair of endpoints in distinct layers contributes the product of intervening layer choices; same-layer endpoint pairs contribute the sum of neighboring layer sizes. This proves the exact path-count formula. The transfer E_j=a_j(E_{j-1}+1) and central all-3 run yield H(L)H(R)3^m+(33/2)m+K. Arbitrary positive fixed tails reduce via beneficial split a>=4, sorting, merging 1+1 into 2 and replacing four 2s with (2,3,3), to eight (1^epsilon,2^j,3^k) profiles. Exact comparisons of three residue classes of tail scores give the stated global fixed-tail constants. Independent exact count checks for m=1..11 and dynamic-tail maxima sizes 7..24 corroborated the infinite combinatorial proof.

evidence: Knor et al., arXiv:2604.04907, equal-size sequential joins, Proposition 3 and open extremal Problem 14.
